name: Spreading Gods Word
overview: The Scriptures call believers to actively spread God's Word by making disciples of all nations, teaching them to obey Christ's commands and baptizing them in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, as emphasized in Matthew 28:19-20. Jesus declares Himself as the only way to the Father, underscoring the exclusive truth of the Gospel that must be proclaimed (John 14:6). Believers are urged to remain steadfast in their confidence in Christ, the true vine, relying on Him as the source of spiritual life and growth (John 15:1; Hebrews 3:14). This mission is carried out with the assurance of Christ's continual presence until the end of the age.
